verdict.rationale: Docs confirm agents can be equipped with tools (crewai-docs-6/23) and tasks specify "required tools" (crewai-docs-2/34), and MCP/tool integration exists, but there's no concrete code snippet showing a typed custom tool class (e.g., BaseTool with a Pydantic args schema) or a minimal "few lines" example as the story asks for. missing for 10: an actual short code example defining a custom tool with typed arguments and attaching it to an Agent, independent confirmation of ease/brevity.
